x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Azure DevOps Classic Designer-to-YAML pipeline conversion tool.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate Azure DevOps YAML pipelines from classic definitions.

options.name: --token
options.description:
Azure DevOps Personal Access Token, or a pipeline access
token e.g. $(System.AccessToken).

options.name: --outputpath
options.description:
Absolute path to YAML output folder [default: Current
Directory]

options.name: --filter
options.description:
Build/Release definition name filter, a case-insensitive
'contains' match rather than a wildcard pattern.

options.name: --phasetype
options.description:
Filter deployment phases [default: AgentBasedDeployment]
Allowed values are: Undefined, AgentBasedDeployment,
RunOnServer, MachineGroupBasedDeployment,
DeploymentGates.
Default value is: AgentBasedDeployment.

options.name: --githubactions
options.description:
Convert to GitHub Actions (also forces inline to true)
[default: false]

options.name: --create-directory
options.description: Create the destination directory if it does not exist
